primaryMetric: validation Log Loss on the identical eligible v1 cohort
selectionRule: Fit a single rho only to 2018-2022 rolling, pre-match rate pairs and observed regulation scores; choose fitted rho only if validation Log Loss is strictly below rho=0, otherwise choose independence. Persist selection before calculating later-period metrics. No sign constraint, no retuning from audit or monitoring.
informationFence: For every rate pair, fit strength using only matches strictly before target date minus one day. rho training labels precede July 1 2023. Neither target score nor later dates can influence its rates. Reset the Poisson warm start at each reported period, keeping identical uncorrected and corrected rates within a comparison.
positivityRule: Use one global rho without fixture-specific projection. Goal rates are capped at 5, so [-0.15,0.039999] keeps all four correction cells strictly positive for every admissible future fixture.
metrics: Brier mean sum of three squared class errors (0-2)
unique-top accuracy with ties counted separately
per-class calibration in ten fixed bins
researchGate: Fitted method must be selected, reduce Brier and Log Loss against uncorrected candidate and v1 in both later periods, and the day-cluster audit interval for Log Loss against uncorrected must be wholly negative. This is descriptive historical evidence, never independent confirmation.
priorExperiment: research/calibration.py and accuracy-calibration-plan-2026-11-05.json already tested Dixon-Coles using in-sample strength estimates; this experiment tests one fixed dependence parameter learned from past rolling out-of-sample rates. It is not the first Dixon-Coles experiment.
limitations: Every reported season and its aggregate draw frequency have already been inspected. This is further retrospective development, not an untouched test.
A marginal draw-frequency gap alone does not establish conditional miscalibration or prove this correction useful.
The strength recipe was selected previously using the same validation seasons; this study does not repeat that grid search.
Goal scores alone are used. News, injuries, lineups and measured xG are not available historical inputs here.
No future packet or new daily job is warranted for an identical rho-zero selection; preserve all existing forecasts.
